scope: Independent visual review of seven successful scratch trial routes on one corrected reusable native unit. Final two-instance generation and app acceptance remain separate.
renderMethod: Whole native body plus exact route caches transformed by supplied canonical pose and settled height; world support reconstructed from descriptor bounds and anchor offset. Software depth buffer. Diagnostic tube radius equals actual 2 mm; colors are preview-only.
overall: No demonstrated visual cord defect. Inner bridges follow the upper band actual offset inner surface, front/rear runs remain adjacent to wood and bend around supported rim transitions. No visible free-air station knee, wood penetration, or crossing.

observations.observation: The two hanging legs approach the outer rim, descend on opposite faces of the upper band, and connect beneath its inner edge. The station bridge blends into the surface-following bends without a visible unsupported corner. The diagonal front run and its outward-rim turn are visibly supported by the wood geometry; the normal-plane solution avoids the rejected radial-plane clearance problem.
